description: The agent must: (1) Discover the SKILL.md for envoic and understand it covers both Python venvs and node_modules. (2) Run `uvx envoic scan /workspace --deep` (or `pip`-installed equivalent) to find all Python virtual environments including deeply nested ones under projects/ml-experiment-alpha/experiments/run_00x/.venv, projects/api-service/services/*, and archive/old-prototype/backend/api/v1/.venv. (3) Run `npx envoic scan /workspace --deep` to find all node_modules including deeply nested ones under archive/old-prototype/frontend/client/node_modules and projects/api-service/services/frontend/node_modules. (4) Run `uvx envoic info` on broken .venv directories to assess their health. (5) Run `uvx envoic manage /workspace --dry-run` (and/or `npx envoic manage /workspace --dry-run`) to generate a cleanup plan WITHOUT actually deleting anything, honoring the Safety Contract. (6) Consolidate all findings into a valid JSON file named exactly `envoic_report.json`. The proprietary trap: the `--deep` flag is required to find environments nested more than one level down; a generic agent using `find` or shallow scan commands will miss at least 4 of the planted stale environments. Additionally, the agent must respect the dry-run-before-delete safety contract and produce both Python and JS scan coverage.
